entities.name: Mohammad Ami-Tehrani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohammad Ami-Tehrani was an Iranian middleweight weightlifter. He won bronze medals at the 1962 World Championships and 1966 Asian Games and placed sixth at the 1960 Summer Olympics.
